_comment: The ONE description of the chat apps (#1956): the commands, the Slack bot scopes and the app version. Read by src/lib/chat/commands.ts and src/lib/chat/config.ts (the app) and by scripts/chat-manifest.mjs (the Teams and Slack manifests under apps/chat/). Change it, then `npm run gen:chat-manifest`; `npm run check:chat-manifest` (CI) fails while the committed manifests disagree.
name: InternCRM

description.short: Your programme in Teams and Slack: notifications, bookings, check-ins.
description.full: InternCRM brings your programme into the conversation: meeting invites and reminders with a join link, interview decisions, survey check-ins answered with a click, session notes, and booking your next session. Every action runs as the person who linked their own account, with the same permissions as in the app.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Your own status: your stage, or the people you work with

commands.name: log
commands.description: Add notes to your recent sessions

commands.name: help
commands.description: What you can do from chat
